subject: Coxph and negative baseline hazard estimates

messages.author: f123286708b19c72
messages.subject: Coxph and negative baseline hazard estimates
parts:
Hello,
I'm doing a little profiling of my survival data with INLA, and I'm a bit confused by the results -- notably that I get negative estimates of the marginal density for the baseline hazard (which is a bath-tub shaped hazard).  

I'm using a combination of interval and right censoring (using inla.surv), and I just noticed that the coxph doc specifies that interval censoring is not allowed -- perhaps this is the problem.  My control.hazard call specifies model='rw1' and n.intervals=20 -- should I also be specifying a strictly positive prior on the piecewise hazards?

Regards,
Dan
